meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Cleans up cookie banners, ads and app prompts on Genius
meta.notes: **Live check (2026-11-13).** Checked `https://genius.com/` in logged-out desktop Chromium at 1512×862. `div[id^="div-gpt-ad"]` matched a 728×90 leaderboard visible in the viewport. No visible cookie or app banner was found. `recipes/fixtures/genius/desktop-real.html` is a sanitized excerpt of the observed ad slot; dynamic ad contents are omitted. Cookie and app selectors remain generic and are not verified for this site.
